rules.fact-sheet: no figures. An investor document is not a lifestyle brochure.
rules.internal-document: no figures, and prefer a low-busy frame so the meta strip stays legible.
rules.newsletter: figures allowed, they warm an editorial cover.
rules.client-statement: figures allowed, prefer matin or midi. This one is personal.
rules.social: figures allowed on announcement formats, avoid on stat formats where the figure is the subject.
rules.always: never reuse the previous issue's image, and recheck the scrim after any swap.
